name: ToolTips
description: Hover/click tooltips for vector features on the map. Put it in the BackgroundMap "overlays" slot. It shows every property a feature carries, so say which ones to leave out rather than which to show.

hideKeys.description: Feature properties NOT to show, e.g. internal ids and render fields. Everything else is shown.

clickTolerance.description: How many pixels away from a feature still counts as being on it.
